actions.title: Download cost document in a project
actions.description: Download generated cost document in a project in BIM 360
actions.help: This action downloads generated document associated with cost in a project.

input.name: urn
input.label: File URN
input.hint: The file URN of the file attachment. This can be retrieved from the Get cost document action. Example: urn:adsk.wipprod:fs.file:vf.K_CpLKJATs9m7Z2RY9TkAuw?version=1 .

actions.name: download_document
actions.title: Download document in a project
actions.description: Download document in a project in BIM 360
actions.help: Retrieve the content of a specific document in the project folder. This content can be used to upload the attachment into another application in subsequent recipe steps.

input.name: chunk_size
input.label: Chunk size (KB)
input.hint: Configure this to optimize throughput. Larger chunk size will increase throughput, but may hit API limit. Default to 1024 KB. Learn more

input.name: folder_id
input.label: Folder name
input.hint: Select folder

input.name: item_id
input.label: File
input.hint: Select file

input.name: download_threads
input.label: Download threads
input.hint: Input number of threads for downloads, default is 1, max is 20

actions.name: upload_document_to_project
actions.title: Upload document to a project
actions.description: Upload document to a project in BIM 360
actions.help: Note that you cannot upload documents to the root folder in BIM 360 Docs; you can only upload documents to the Project Files folder or to a folder nested under the Project Files folder. To enable upload files larger than 10MB, please provide the file size in the file size input.

input.name: folder_id
input.label: Folder name
input.hint: Select folder

input.name: file_name
input.label: File name
input.hint: File name should include extension of the file. e.g. my_file.jpg . The name of the file (1-255 characters). Reserved characters: , :, ", /, \, |, ?, *, `, \n, \r, \t, \0, \f, ¢, ™, $, ®

input.name: file_content
input.label: Contents
input.hint: The file contents to upload

input.name: file_size
input.label: File size
input.hint: Enter file size if available (in bytes) for streaming upload.

input.name: upload_threads
input.label: Upload threads
input.hint: Input number of threads for downloads, default is 10, max is 20

input.name: item_id
input.label: Item ID
input.hint: Provide item object ID for creating a new version of the item.

input.name: version_type
input.label: Type of version
input.hint: Only relevant for creating files - the type of version.

input.name: extension_type_version
input.label: Extension type version
input.hint: The version of the version extension type. The current version is 1.0
